rows.available: For an imaginary quadratic order O_f, its proper invertible ideal class group is I_K(f)/P_(K,Z)(f), and arithmetic Artin identifies this with the Galois group of its ring class field, unramified outside f. Conjugation acts by inversion. The map to the maximal-order class group has the residue-unit kernel described by (7.25)–(7.27) when O_K*=±1.
rows.needed: The inert K-prime (ell), prime to fn_I, splits completely in H_(fn_I), and its residue field is F_(ell^2).
rows.derivation: The invertible prime ideal equals the rational principal ideal (ell), hence has trivial class in Pic(O_(fn_I)). Unramifiedness and trivial arithmetic Frobenius give complete splitting. Since ell is inert in K/Q, its base residue degree is two; complete splitting does not turn it into an F_ell residue field. This gives F² Xbar=Xbar. The norm and CM reduction identities in H13 remain separate.
premises: Actual imaginary K and allowed conductor fn_I; ell inert, new and prime to conductor; same class-field Artin convention.
The restriction identity H11 and point norm/reduction identities are separate inputs.
